name: powershell-core
description: PowerShell 7+ - Cross-platform automation and configuration tool built on .NET Core

pwsh.description: PowerShell 7+ - Modern cross-platform shell and scripting language with object pipeline
pwsh.usage:
pwsh # Start interactive PowerShell session
pwsh -Command "Get-Process | Where-Object {$_.CPU -gt 100}" # Run command
pwsh -File script.ps1 # Execute script
pwsh -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File script.ps1 # Bypass execution policy
pwsh -NoProfile -Command "1..10 | ForEach-Object {Write-Host $_}" # No profile load
pwsh -EncodedCommand <base64> # Execute base64 encoded command
